:::{#rem-integral-nonneg-lower-sums}
#### Each sum is a lower estimate

Each sum in @def-integral-nonneg splits $S$ into pieces
and weights each piece $A_i$ by the smallest value $f$ approaches on it,
so each sum is at most the integral.
For Lebesgue measure on a closed interval $[a, b]$
and a function $f \ge 0$ that has a
[Riemann integral](calculus.qmd#def-riemann-integral) on $[a, b]$,
the two integrals agree:
$\int_{[a, b]} f \, d\lebesgue = \int_a^b f(x) \, dx$
[@wikipedia_lebesgue_integration].

:::
